asked.item: Meaning of 'You're On Heygen Free Plan' error
Do I need to pay HeyGen for this to work with Blotato

verdict.reason: The CREATE HEYGEN AVATAR VIDEO errors section says the HeyGen API requires a paid API plan and the Free API plan won't work.

steps.text: "You're On Heygen Free Plan" is one of the most common reasons the CREATE HEYGEN AVATAR VIDEO step fails.
HeyGen API requires you to pay for its $99/mo API plan.
The Free API plan won't work.
